overview.description: The Unlimited HFEQ Equity Long/Short ETF (HFEQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long/short alternatives. The fund aims to outperform the hedge fund industrys equity long/short sector by investing in equity ETFs and futures with similar return characteristics, while targeting a volatility level that is roughly twice that of the sector. HFEQ was launched on Jul 14, 2025 and is issued by Unlimited.
